messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Novak <alex@zenon.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: RAG eval next steps & reranker recommendation — Zenon AI

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on Zenon’s customer support RAG use case and the latency/accuracy tradeoffs you care about. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can scope a short POC: 

What I heard: 
- Primary workload: multi-year support tickets + KB + product docs (avg doc length ~2.1k chars).
- SLAs: median latency target ~600ms for first token (interactive UI).
- Quality: customer-facing answers must cite sources and keep hallucination rate <5% on a labelled prompt set.

Immediate Redwood recommendations (initial POC config):
- Retriever: sparse+vector hybrid (BM25 for recall priming + FAISS HNSW on redwood-embed-v2).
- Chunking: 600 token stride, 1.5k char chunk size (overlap 20%).
- Top-K retrieval: candidate_k = 50, rerank_top_k = 5.
- Reranker: cross-encoder recommender -> use re-rank-xlarge (fine-tune optional). We typically pair a fast bi-encoder for recall then a cross-encoder for precision.
- Grounding/thresholding: citation_score threshold = 0.7; if no doc >= threshold fall back to safe reply template.

Evaluation plan we propose for the POC:
- Shared prompt sets: 120 labelled prompts (mix of short/long asks, multi-turn context).
- Metrics: precision@k, grounding_score (weighted citation+exact-match), hallucination_rate (human-annotated), latency P50/P95, cost_per_1000_token.
- Benchmarks: we’ll run our Redwood RAG eval harness and share a reproducible report (example: https://redwood.dev/benchmarks/rag-rerank-2025).

Next steps I suggest: 
1) You share a small sample of production queries & a subset of documents (sanitized) — we can use your sample to run a baseline. (Samira, if you want to upload, zenon-query-sample.csv is fine.)
2) We exchange the evaluation template I attached (redwood_rag_eval_template.xlsx) so you can confirm the prompt set.
3) Engineer sync: Rishi will propose an initial infra config and estimate for the POC.
4) Target: 2-week technical POC, 4-week business validation (if we get sample data this week).

Attachments: redwood_rag_eval_template.xlsx (template for prompt sets & metrics)

If that all sounds right, I’ll get Rishi to propose the retrieval/reranker parameters and schedule a 30-min scoping call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Note: For reproducibility we’ll log the exact model variants used (embed/redwood-embed-v2; reranker/re-rank-xlarge) in the POC proposal.

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks for the sample you uploaded — I pulled zenon-query-sample.csv and looked at length distributions. Based on the sample, here’s a concrete initial config we’d run for the 2-week technical POC: 

Proposed POC config (first pass):
- Ingest: chunk documents at ~600 tokens (approx 1.5k chars) with 120-token overlap. Extract metadata (doc_id, title, source).
- Index: hybrid index — BM25 for recall priming feeding candidate set into FAISS HNSW (embedding model redwood-embed-v2).
- Retrieval stage: candidate_k = 50; filter by recency where applicable (we’ll add a date_boost for tickets in last 12 months).
- Rerank stage: rerank_top_k = 5 using cross-encoder re-rank-xlarge (latency P50 expected ~220ms on dedicated GPU for 5-item rerank; we can push to batch rerank to save compute).
- Response assembly: include top-2 citations in UI, show confidence badge = citation_score. If citation_score < 0.7 return conservative fallback.

Evaluation & metrics instrumentation: 
- Grounding_score = 0.6 * citation_precision + 0.4 * exact_answer_match (annotated sample). We’ll provide the scoring notebook.
- Hallucination detection: automatic heuristics (entity mismatch) + human spot-checking on 200 samples.
- Latency: measure end-to-end P50/P95 including reranker time and network overhead.

POC resource estimate (approx):
- 2-week run on dedicated test node (1x A10G or equivalent) + 4h/day human annotation (4 annotators) 
- Estimated infra cost (Redwood hosted trial): ~$7.5k — includes indexing, 2-week rerank runs, and analysis report (we’ll provide a detailed line item).

Links & artifacts:
- Baseline benchmark we’ll run: https://redwood.dev/benchmarks/rag-rerank-2025
- POC eval template: https://drive.google.com/zenon/rag-eval-plan
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/zenon/record/ZN-1427

If Alex/Samira are good with that scope, I’ll schedule a 30-min technical scoping session and I’ll upload the scoring notebook to the Drive link above.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Rishi / Marissa —

Appreciate the detailed config and the cost estimate — that looks reasonable. Two quick items before we lock dates: 
1) PO privacy: we need guidance on k-anonymizing query logs and removing PII before upload. Can you include a short checklist for sanitization?
2) Timeline: if data is ready by EOD Thursday, can Redwood start indexing Friday and kick off the POC next Monday? 

If both are good I’ll get Samira to sign off and we’ll issue a short SOW.

Quick +1 on the grounding_score definition — we’ll review the scoring notebook when it’s uploaded.

Thanks — Alex
